metadata.question: Does the agricultural land around Peoria, Illinois show more brown fields in October 2022 compared to September 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Peoria, Illinois (~40.69°N, -89.59°W) - Collection: Sentinel-2 or Landsat (better for agricultural monitoring) - Dates: September 2022 vs October 2022 - Need to define agricultural area around Peoria 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds to get clear pixels - Focus on agricultural land (exclude urban areas if possible) - Brown fields = harvested/bare soil vs green vegetation 3. Logic: - Use NDVI or vegetation index to detect brown (low NDVI) vs green (high NDVI) - Brown fields = lower NDVI values (bare soil after harvest) - Compare mean NDVI: if October < September, more brown fields (Answer A) - Valid Zero: NDVI can be legitimately low (0.1-0.3 for bare soil) - C3: if NDVI > 1 or < -1, or None - C2: if no valid pixels after cloud masking - C1: if no images in either period ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions peoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.59, 40.69]).buffer(20000) # 20km radius around Peoria sep_start = '2022-09-01' sep_end = '2022-09-30' oct_start = '2022-10-01' oct_end = '2022-10-31' # 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 def mask_s2_clouds(image): qa = image.select('QA60') cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0)) return image.updateMask(cloud_mask) # 3. Data Acquisition - September sep_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterBounds(peoria) \ .filterDate(sep_start, sep_end) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \ .map(mask_s2_clouds) sep_size = sep_col.size().getInfo() print(f"September 2022 Images: {sep_size}") if sep_size == 0: # Fallback to Landsat 9 sep_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterBounds(peoria) \ .filterDate(sep_start, sep_end) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)) sep_size = sep_col.size().getInfo() print(f"September 2022 Landsat Images: {sep_size}") if sep_size == 0: print("C1") exit() # 4. Data Acquisition - October oct_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \ .filterBounds(peoria) \ .filterDate(oct_start, oct_end) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \ .map(mask_s2_clouds) oct_size = oct_col.size().getInfo() print(f"October 2022 Images: {oct_size}") if oct_size == 0: # Fallback to Landsat 9 oct_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \ .filterBounds(peoria) \ .filterDate(oct_start, oct_end) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)) oct_size = oct_col.size().getInfo() print(f"October 2022 Landsat Images: {oct_size}") if oct_size == 0: print("C1") exit() # 5. Calculate NDVI if 'COPERNICUS' in sep_col.first().get('system:id').getInfo(): # Sentinel-2 def add_ndvi(image): ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI') return image.addBands(ndvi) else: # Landsat 9 def add_ndvi(image): ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI') return image.addBands(ndvi) sep_ndvi = sep_col.map(add_ndvi).select('NDVI').median() oct_ndvi = oct_col.map(add_ndvi).select('NDVI').median() # 6. Reduce to statistics sep_stats = sep_ndvi.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=peoria, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() oct_stats = oct_ndvi.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=peoria, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() sep_mean = sep_stats.get('NDVI_mean') sep_count = sep_stats.get('NDVI_count') oct_mean = oct_stats.get('NDVI_mean') oct_count = oct_stats.get('NDVI_count') print(f"September - Mean NDVI: {sep_mean:.3f}, Valid Pixels: {int(sep_count) if sep_count else 0}") print(f"October - Mean NDVI: {oct_mean:.3f}, Valid Pixels: {int(oct_count) if oct_count else 0}") # 7. Validation & Answer if sep_count == 0 or oct_count == 0: print("C2") elif sep_mean is None or oct_mean is None or sep_mean > 1 or sep_mean < -1 or oct_mean > 1 or oct_mean < -1: print("C3") elif oct_mean < sep_mean: print("October NDVI is lower - more brown fields") print("A") else: print("October NDVI is not lower - not more brown fields") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
peoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.59, 40.69]).buffer(20000)  # 20km radius around Peoria
sep_start = '2022-09-01'
sep_end = '2022-09-30'
oct_start = '2022-10-01'
oct_end = '2022-10-31'

# 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask)

# 3. Data Acquisition - September
sep_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(peoria) \
    .filterDate(sep_start, sep_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

sep_size = sep_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"September 2022 Images: {sep_size}")

if sep_size == 0:
    # Fallback to Landsat 9
    sep_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(peoria) \
        .filterDate(sep_start, sep_end) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30))
    sep_size = sep_col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"September 2022 Landsat Images: {sep_size}")
    if sep_size == 0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 4. Data Acquisition - October
oct_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(peoria) \
    .filterDate(oct_start, oct_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

oct_size = oct_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"October 2022 Images: {oct_size}")

if oct_size == 0:
    # Fallback to Landsat 9
    oct_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(peoria) \
        .filterDate(oct_start, oct_end) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30))
    oct_size = oct_col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"October 2022 Landsat Images: {oct_size}")
    if oct_size == 0:
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 5. Calculate NDVI
if 'COPERNICUS' in sep_col.first().get('system:id').getInfo():
    # Sentinel-2
    def add_ndvi(image):
        ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
        return image.addBands(ndvi)
else:
    # Landsat 9
    def add_ndvi(image):
        ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI')
        return image.addBands(ndvi)

sep_ndvi = sep_col.map(add_ndvi).select('NDVI').median()
oct_ndvi = oct_col.map(add_ndvi).select('NDVI').median()

# 6. Reduce to statistics
sep_stats = sep_ndvi.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=peoria,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

oct_stats = oct_ndvi.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=peoria,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

sep_mean = sep_stats.get('NDVI_mean')
sep_count = sep_stats.get('NDVI_count')
oct_mean = oct_stats.get('NDVI_mean')
oct_count = oct_stats.get('NDVI_count')

print(f"September - Mean NDVI: {sep_mean:.3f}, Valid Pixels: {int(sep_count) if sep_count else 0}")
print(f"October - Mean NDVI: {oct_mean:.3f}, Valid Pixels: {int(oct_count) if oct_count else 0}")

# 7. Validation & Answer
if sep_count == 0 or oct_count == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif sep_mean is None or oct_mean is None or sep_mean > 1 or sep_mean < -1 or oct_mean > 1 or oct_mean < -1:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif oct_mean < sep_mean:
    print("October NDVI is lower - more brown fields")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("October NDVI is not lower - not more brown fields")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
